description: This file defines the UploadSession model and related functions for handling file uploads in the Mattermost project, including validation, auditing, and constants for upload types.

classes.name: UploadSession
classes.description: Contains information used to keep track of a file upload, including validation and auditing methods.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of the upload session's key attributes for auditing purposes.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Fills in required information such as Id and CreateAt timestamp before saving.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Validates the upload session's fields and returns an error if invalid.
